Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a GFP-tagged SEPT9 bait. While the search parameters included phosphorylation, it was used as a variable modification during the search of the AP-MS interactome rather than a dedicated phosphoproteome enrichment workflow.

scope: Using affinity-purification mass spectrometry, super-resolution imaging, and genetic KO, we determined that SEPT9 interacts with and is necessary to recruit nonmuscle myosin IIC (NMIIC) to the IEC perijunctional actomyosin belt.
we next determined the interactome of SEPT9 in IECs by performing affinity purification mass spectrometry (APMS) on pulldowns of SEPT9-GFP overexpressed in DLD-1 cells.
SEPT9-GFP protein was purified by coimmunoprecipitation, digested with trypsin, and desalted using ChromoTek iST GFP-Trap IP-MS sample preparation kit

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzed the interactome of SEPT9 via affinity purification (APMS/Co-IP) from DLD-1 cells, rather than a whole cell lysate.
